verdict.rationale: Fellow documents a REST Developer API with per-endpoint reference pages, but the evidence never shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. A probe found every common spec path (openapi.json, swagger.json, /api/openapi.json, /.well-known/openapi.json) returning 404. The llms.txt file that does exist is a documentation index, not a machine-readable API specification, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
